prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: vehicle actor portrait for a gritty American post-apocalyptic tabletop RPG, first asset in a matched portrait/top-down token set.
Primary request: paint one believable, still-drivable late-1980s American four-door full-size sedan parked on a broken highway shoulder. It has a long squared hood, squared trunk, conventional closed metal roof, four ordinary road wheels, dull chrome rectangular grille, rectangular headlights. Sun-faded muted blue-green paint, surface rust around wheel arches and seams, one replacement grey DRIVER'S FRONT door, dusty windows. A simple narrow steel roof rack holds one modest rectangular bundle wrapped in dirty olive canvas with two brown straps; leave the front and rear roof edges visible. Dark brown worn seats, left-hand drive. No armour, no spikes, no weapons.
Style/medium: grounded hand-painted RPG illustration, realistic proportions and materials, confident dark edges and crisp readable painted detail. Subtle brush texture, restrained colours. The worn painted materials should match the reference portrait's illustration technique ONLY. Do not include any subject, person, equipment, clothing or weapon from that reference.
Composition/framing: square image, entire car and all four wheels in frame with breathing room; front three-quarter view from the driver's front corner, looking slightly down so the hood and roof rack are readable. Car dominates 80% of frame. Front points toward image lower-left. North American road and scrub in the quiet background, no skyline distraction.
Lighting/mood: cool neutral daylight, softly overcast, readable detail and form. No dramatic orange lighting, no fog.
Constraints: one vehicle only; no humans, no riders, no animals; no lettering, numbers, branding, licence plate characters, symbols or watermark. Generic 1980s North American sedan, no identifiable make required. This portrait establishes a vehicle design that will later be reproduced from strictly overhead.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: orthographic top-down vehicle token for Foundry VTT.
Input image: SUBJECT IDENTITY reference, the same battered 1980s American sedan. Preserve its design, faded blue-green paint, grey driver's FRONT door, roof rack with a single olive canvas bundle and two brown straps, dull chrome bumpers, squared front and rear, realistic proportions and weathering.
Primary request: depict THIS EXACT SEDAN viewed vertically from directly overhead. This is a painted battle-map miniature asset, with crisp dark edges and readable hand-painted materials matching the reference, restrained realistic detail.
CAMERA: strict 90-degree orthographic plan view looking straight down. Absolutely no perspective, no visible vertical grille or vertical door surfaces, no horizon. Vehicle perfectly straight, centered, longitudinal axis vertical, FRONT BUMPER AND HOOD AT THE BOTTOM, TRUNK AND REAR BUMPER AT THE TOP. Left-hand-drive car: driver's side is IMAGE-RIGHT when the front points down. Grey replacement front door on IMAGE-RIGHT at the front cabin. The tailpipe terminates at image-left rear, around x30%, y3% of the final frame. Roof is closed. Front windshield at the bottom of the cabin, rear windshield at its top. Keep front hood long and flat, trunk shorter, cabin central. Four road wheels tucked under body arches, small mirrors symmetric.
FRAMING: portrait canvas aspect ratio 1:2, vehicle's physical width:length about 1:2.45 including mirrors. Entire vehicle bumper to bumper fills 94% of canvas HEIGHT, centered with clear transparent margins on ALL four sides. No object touches an edge.
BACKGROUND: genuine fully transparent alpha. No road, ground, backdrop, dust cloud, smoke, tyre tracks, grid, text, circular frame, ring, base or ground shadow. Soft self-shadow only inside vehicle.
LIGHT: neutral daylight from upper left, natural muted blue-green, rust brown, charcoal glass and olive canvas.
CONSTRAINTS: same ONE vehicle, no people inside or outside, no occupants, no weapons, no logos, lettering, numbers, symbols, plate characters or watermark. Do not depict the highway from the portrait.

Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: roof-hidden / interior-visible variant of this exact Foundry VTT vehicle token.
Edit target: the supplied strict overhead blue-green sedan token. Preserve the original canvas dimensions, exact position, orientation, size, bounding silhouette, all transparent margins and alpha edges. This must match the original when switched on a battle map.

CHANGE ONLY THE PASSENGER CABIN, between the rear windshield and front windshield:
Make a clean architectural roof-hidden cutaway, revealing an EMPTY practical five-seat cabin. The removable roof panel, roof rack and olive strapped luggage disappear together; remove only these and the cabin window glazing necessary to see inside. Do not damage or dismantle the vehicle. Keep the narrow outer body/door sills and pillar stubs. Keep the hood and trunk closed and exactly unchanged. Keep both bumpers, all wheels, mirrors, tailpipe and paint chips outside the cabin EXACTLY unchanged in the exact same pixels.
Interior: two brown worn upholstered front bucket seats with headrests, a simple dark centre console, brown rear bench for three, a dusty dark floor and conventional dashboard at the front of the cabin, nearest the BOTTOM of the image. The steering wheel is at the front IMAGE-RIGHT, because the vehicle faces down and is left-hand drive. Seats face toward the BOTTOM. There is useful floor space in front of seats; absolutely no occupant.
Render with the same strict 90-degree overhead camera, same crisp painterly outline, same realistic materials, same neutral upper-left lighting as the original. The cabin is readable and naturally integrated, not a detached interior diagram.
Constraints: edit within cabin only; no change in framing or scale; no perspective shift; front remains down, rear up. The FRONT HOOD is at bottom and the REAR TRUNK is at top; both remain covered. No open engine bay or open trunk. No spare roof laid beside the vehicle. No background, ground, cast shadow, ring, grid, labels, text, number, logo or watermark. Genuine transparent background, same alpha outside vehicle.

Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: ROOF_OFF battle-map token of the supplied ROOF_ON sedan. User-directed correction.

EDIT TARGET: this supplied closed-roof top-down sedan, 887x1774 canvas, front pointing DOWN.
Keep its exact canvas, scale, centering, front-down orthographic orientation, transparent background, outer body silhouette, wheels, mirrors, tailpipe, hood, trunk and bumpers.

REMOVE THE WHOLE UPPER CABIN, NOT JUST A HOLE IN THE ROOF:
- Remove the roof, roof rack and luggage.
- Remove ALL window glazing: the front windshield, rear windshield, and side windows.
- Remove ALL roof-support pillars A, B and C, the chrome window frames, roof gutters and the narrow raised metal perimeter around the old roof.
- This is a CLEAN VTT ROOF-HIDDEN CUTAWAY, not a convertible conversion or wreck. Cut down to the broad cabin's beltline. No thin metal or chrome window surround should remain fencing in the passenger compartment.
- Reveal ONE continuous broad, roomy empty interior from the forward edge of the trunk at approximately y300 to the rear edge of the hood/cowl at approximately y1160, and across the full usable cabin width to the side door beltlines (roughly x175 to x715). The old rear-window area and the old side-window areas must now belong to the revealed open interior. Preserve only the lower doors and their outer body skin, which may read as a thin low sill.
- There must be no surviving rear window, side window triangles, glass strips or upright chrome pillars. Keep the hood and trunk CLOSED, blue-green and exactly as they are.

CRITICAL REGISTRATION OF EXISTING INTERIOR:
Study the two brown front seats already visible THROUGH THE FRONT WINDSHIELD of the original image. Preserve those EXISTING front seats in their EXACT ORIGINAL PIXEL LOCATIONS, proportions and direction. Simply remove the glass that covers them and reveal the hidden continuations. Do not create a new front row further toward the rear, do not move the seats up toward the centre of the roof. The steering wheel is already correctly placed at image-right near the lower edge of the cabin: keep it in precisely that location. The seats face DOWN toward it. Likewise, use the brown rear seating glimpsed through the old rear windshield as the registration reference for the rear bench, not a moved row.
Make the exposed cabin broad and useful on a game map, with a continuous dark dusty floor, two worn brown front seats anchored to their existing positions, a simple centre console, and a broad three-place brown rear bench. No additional rows, no people.
Important: readability and space for large player token overlays matter more than perfectly cramped real-car packaging.

RENDERING: same crisp detailed hand-painted materials and neutral upper-left lighting as the original token. Natural dark brown upholstery and charcoal floor. No ground, no cast shadow, no border, text, labels, numbers, symbols, watermarks, detached roof or spare parts. Preserve true alpha background.
